title: End-of-support transition playbook for legacy model revisions
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Define an operational playbook for transitioning customers off legacy model revisions while preserving runtime SLAs and minimizing regressions. This ticket covers: (1) timing and cadence for end-of-support (EoS) announcements, (2) documentation and migration artifacts (migration guides, example pinned configs, performance profile diffs), (3) automated SDK/CLI warnings and opt-in migration tooling, (4) telemetry-driven triggers that escalate notices and open support workflows, and (5) the short-term compatibility shim and rollback guardrails for critical customers. We're aiming for a low-friction customer experience: clear notices, one-click pinning/rollback guidance, and measurable quality/latency comparisons so teams can make informed decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Public EoS announcement template created and approved by Legal & Support
Migration guide published for at least 3 popular replacement model variants with token-cost and latency comparisons
Performance profile diff (old vs recommended) published in Console and linked from migration guide
SDK and CLI emit deprecation warning when users call deprecated model versions, with link to migration guide
Automated telemetry rule that flags customers using deprecated models for >90% of requests and creates a Support task
Compatibility shim plan documented: API compatibility checklist and time-limited fallback policy for major incidents
Rollout checklist and runbook for execution day, including rollback triggers and stakeholder pager list
tasks: Draft customer-facing EoS notice copy and 60/30/14/7 day cadence schedule
Author migration guides: quickstart, config examples (pin-by-default, pin-with-compat-shim), and sample prompts to validate parity
Publish performance profiles for replacement models and add delta visualization in Console
Implement SDK warning banner and CLI exit code + URL linking to migration playbook
Build telemetry alert: deprecated_model_usage_ratio > 0.75 over 7d -> create Support ticket
Create internal runbook: escalation matrix, rollback steps, and change freeze window
Coordinate with Sales & CSMs for a customer impact list and prioritized outreach
Schedule a cross-functional readiness review: Eng (runtime), Console, Docs, Support, Legal
communication_plan: Phase 0 (T-60d): internal announcement + CSM/Sales readiness list
Phase 1 (T-30d): public EoS notice to customers using legacy models; console banner added
Phase 2 (T-14d): targeted emails to high-usage customers with migration playbook and offered 1:1 assist
Phase 3 (T-0): deprecation takes effect; SDK warnings become errors in non-backcompat modes; compatibility shim active for 14 days
Phase 4 (T+14d): compatibility shim removed for non-exempt customers; permanent archive of old performance telemetry
Ongoing: post-closure survey and automated quality telemetry monitoring for customers that migrated
compatibility_shim_summary: Short-lived translation layer to accept deprecated model names and route to recommended variants with minimal behavioral adjustments. Shim will: adjust sampling seeds, apply a small post-processing filter to align tokens when possible, and log per-request fidelity scores. Shim will be enabled for 14 days post-EoS for customers on the exception list. Shim implementation owned by ENG/runtime team and must include a kill-switch and per-customer opt-out.
telemetry_triggers: deprecated_model_usage_ratio > 0.75 for rolling 7d window -> open Support ticket and tag account for CSM outreach
sudden drop in request success rate (>5%) after migration attempt -> automatic incident stub in PagerDuty
quality-regression signal (prompt-eval fail rate increase >10%) for migrated customers -> create regression analysis task
metrics_to_track: % of active customers migrated off deprecated versions by T-0, T+14, T+90
median token cost delta between legacy and recommended models
p50/p95 latency delta for representative workloads
prompt-eval pass rate for provided canonical prompt sets
support tickets opened with 'model migration' tag
support_playbook_summary: Support playbook includes triage flows for: (A) customer sees functional regressions after migration (provide rollback pin + assist), (B) latency regressions (assist with batching/quantization recommendations), (C) billing disputes tied to cost delta (CSM & Billing review). Must include canned responses, escalation tags, and recommended internal owner per case. Support also gets a prioritized list from telemetry for proactive outreach.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: High-volume customers may experience unplanned latency spikes. Mitigation: pre-migration perf testing and canary on dedicated capacity
Risk: Customers rely on subtle model behaviors not covered by prompt-evals. Mitigation: provide a user-facing prompt-eval harness and offer assisted parity testing
Risk: Legal/regulatory objections for Private deployments. Mitigation: include Legal in sign-off and provide extended timeline and audit logs
